source.source_binding_markers: low-area binary-luminance barcode outside the central answer region; first 64 frames only
source.source_content_identities: fixtures/*.mp4 SHA-256 plus per-frame source RGB, decoded native RGB, source index and PTS records

selection.runtime_changes: none; evaluate newest official main 2b0403b or newer
selection.quality_anchor_rule: Every case has source-grounded answer evidence. Required temporal budgets must contain the declared answer evidence before freezing. Default/uniform absence is measured, not repaired or excluded.

cases.question: Which shape moves in the middle of the three separated motion events? Answer with one shape name.
在这段连续运动中，最后移动的图案是什么？只回答图案名称。
¿Qué símbolo aparece después del tercer cambio de escena? Responde solo con el nombre del símbolo.
¿Cuántos cambios de escena hay en todo el video? Responde solo con el número.
長い静止区間で中央に保たれている形は何ですか？形の名前だけで答えてください。
Quel symbole est visible dans le tout premier cadre du video ? Réponds uniquement avec le nom du symbole.
Which symbol appears in the final frame? Answer with one symbol name.
Welche Form bewegt sich unmittelbar nach dem Dreieck? Antworte nur mit dem Namen der Form.
How many separated motion episodes contain a cross? Answer only with the count.
Quale simbolo appare nel breve lampo nella seconda metà del video? Rispondi solo con il nome del simbolo.

scoring.expect_all_semantics: every preregistered term must occur in the casefolded raw answer
scoring.expect_any_group_semantics: at least one preregistered canonical-language term must occur in the casefolded raw answer
limitations: substring matching can over- or under-count linguistic variants
three repeated deterministic answers are not independent semantic examples
ten procedural synthetic cases do not establish natural-video or perceptual generalization

measurement.mode_execution: fresh sequential stacks on the same physical GPU; never simultaneously resident
measurement.prefix_cache: disabled; prefix_reused=0 for every request including warmup
measurement.native_evidence: exact selected RGB/source index/PTS/presentation order, temporal-2 pair-first timestamps, mRoPE digest, serial/batch and repetition parity, complete binary/model/source provenance

analysis_plan.paired_unit: case x execution mode; sum its three measured hits, then classify improved/worsened/unchanged
analysis_plan.sign_test: exact two-sided sign test over discordant paired case/mode units; zero discordant pairs gives p=1.0
analysis_plan.uncertainty: Wilson 95 percent interval over 60 request-level measured answers per arm/budget; repetitions are not independent semantic examples
analysis_plan.per_case_reporting: every measured raw answer and hit by case/mode/repetition/arm/budget, plus every miss with request identity
analysis_plan.latency_outliers: Tukey upper fence Q3+1.5*IQR within each measured mode/arm/budget and metric total/native_elapsed; if IQR=0, every value above Q3 is an outlier; no value is removed
analysis_plan.quality_regression_recording: retain and report every temporal hit-to-miss transition against the same-budget uniform arm and temporal-8 against default-8; never alter runtime or scoring
no_regression_technical_gates: 560 completed and native-valid requests with cold prefixes
500 exact default/uniform, serial/batch-four and repetition parity checks
default-8 and uniform-8 answers and native diagnostics byte-identical
exclusive GPU1, in_flight=0, bounded residual memory and post-stop cleanup
analysis_plan.acceptance_behavior: This is evaluation, not a promotion gate. Quality improvement is not required for a technical PASS and no result triggers a runtime edit.
